identity: Independent implementations in numpy and scipy of the closed forms, of the grey two-stream moment equations (solve_ivp, DOP853 for the pinned depths, rtol 1e-12) and of the exact grey solution (the Milne equation, collocation with exact exponential-integral kernels, self-tested against the Hopf constants); astropy constants for k, G, sigma, u. No Gravitas code ran; no external published radiative-transfer code was used.
environment: Prompt 180 scratch virtual environment as it was; nothing installed
